drivers.evidence: DXY was 103.598 at 07:04 HKT, above Monday’s provider close of 103.550. Reuters described an intraday 19-month high. A stronger dollar makes gold more expensive for overseas buyers.
Tuesday’s Treasury real yield fell 3bp to 2.89%, and the nominal 10-year yield fell 2bp to 5.10%, versus Monday. Lower after-inflation yields reduce the interest income forgone by holding gold.

Investing.com’s 07:05 HKT update put December’s +50bp probability at 1.7%, down from 2.1% in the prior edition. But January’s modal cumulative +50bp increase rose to 75.4% from 72.9%. Less near-term tightening pressure helps gold, while a firmer January rate outlook works against it.
drivers.why: The December tail softened, but January’s modal cumulative hike became more likely.

drivers.evidence: AP reported fresh Iran-US strikes and a tanker attack on Tuesday, adding haven risk. Reuters quoted an analyst saying the AI-share unwind could force gold selling to raise cash. These are opposing haven-demand and cash-liquidation channels, not a verified single cause of the latest quote.
drivers.why: Escalation can support haven demand, but cash-raising can force bullion selling.

gold.competing: The dollar remained slightly firmer while real yields fell. Fed pricing was less aggressive for December but firmer for January’s modal outcome. Equity stress can create both haven demand and selling to raise cash. The channels conflict, so evidence confidence stays Low.
gold.would_change: FOMC minutes at 03:00 HKT Thursday could change the expected pace of rate increases. A sustained change in real yields would matter more than hawkish wording alone.

ai_stories.paragraph: A data centre is a building full of computers, and Nvidia sells chips that do calculations for AI. Think of a company supplying equipment to many busy workshops. Nvidia reported third quarter revenue of US$115.8 billion on November 17, more than double a year earlier. Its Data Center business supplied US$107.6 billion of that total, up 110%. Management forecasts US$130 billion in revenue for the next quarter, plus or minus 3%. That quarter has an additional week, and the forecast assumes no Data Center computing revenue from China. How closely actual sales will match the forecast remains open.
ai_stories.headline: Nvidia revenue doubles, with a larger quarter forecast
facts: Nvidia's 17 November 2026 release reports third-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% year on year.
Data Center revenue was $107.6 billion, up 110% year on year.
For Q4 it forecasts revenue of $130 billion, plus or minus 3%, and gross margins between 71% and 72%.
Q4 includes an additional week, and guidance assumes no Data Center compute revenue from China.
A forecast is a management estimate, not an achieved result.
Single-source company announcement: forecast and availability claims are attributed to the company.

ai_stories.paragraph: A coding model takes instructions and information from a software project, then generates or changes code. For example, a developer could ask it to edit a function and explain the change. Microsoft announced MAI Code 2 and Code 2 Flash on November 17 and says both are available in GitHub Copilot and Microsoft Foundry. It positions Code 2 for complex programming work and Flash for faster routine edits and explanations. Microsoft's comparisons of cost and quality come from its own tests. How well either model handles a customer's particular code remains to be established, and generated changes still need checking.

lens.mechanics: Prices rise when money and credit spent grow faster than output. Gold pays no interest, so lower after-inflation bond returns reduce the income given up by holding it.
lens.data: Three forces matter. First, the real yield fell to 2.89% on 17 Nov, helping gold through that channel. Second, inflation compensation rose to 2.21% on 17 Nov. Third, the broad dollar index was 122.6503 on 13 Nov, a stale input. Normally lower real returns support gold. This time the currency pressure and reported demand for cash complicate that template.
lens.unsustainable: Debt cannot indefinitely outgrow revenue without adjustment. Cuts, restructuring, transfers or monetary expansion shift who bears the cost.
lens.would_change: FOMC minutes at 03:00 HKT Thursday could change the expected pace of rate increases. A sustained change in real yields would matter more than hawkish wording alone.

longview.cycle: The checklist still suggests a highly indebted phase: debt grew relative to output and annual revenue, while foreign Treasury holdings grew more slowly than a year earlier. A household spending more income on interest has less room for other bills. The comparison has limits: the government issues its own currency, and these interest and revenue observations are from different quarters. Negative yield-growth gaps using one annualised quarter do not establish sustainable financing or predict a crisis date.
longview.asset_classes: Positive after-inflation Treasury yields compete with gold. Cash earns short-term interest and loses buying power if prices rise faster. If debt pressure leads to easing that cuts real returns, gold can gain through that channel. Bonds depend on inflation and repayment terms, while stocks depend on productivity and profits outrunning financing costs.
